purpose: Immutable source-required complete-method floors for route map, camera focus and branch history. Estimates are unmeasured and never runtime guarantees. Removing profile entries, whole classes, names or semantic markers cannot reduce current-source floors.

derivation.formula: launches*90 + explicit_wait_caps + reveal_calls*(maximum_swipes+1)*2 + 60, rounded upward to 10 seconds
derivation.limitation: Unmeasured engineering allowances, not observed durations or guaranteed upper bounds. Includes each complete method, all fixture launches, assertions, helpers, setup/teardown and conditional failure screenshot.
